page.content:
Strongest of the heroes, driven through twelve labors by Hera's hatred.

How Heracles connects

  • Character: Hera — Hera's hatred drives Heracles into the twelve labors.
  • Character: Cerberus — Heracles' last labor is to fetch Cerberus from Hades.
  • Character: Prometheus — Heracles later frees Prometheus from the rock.

What is Heracles?

Heracles, son of Zeus and Alcmene, is forced into the twelve labors after Hera maddens him. He binds Cerberus, slays the Hydra, and is later received on Olympus.

Key threads lead to Hera, Cerberus and Prometheus.
